All 14 tests in test_iteration5_shift_log.py pass (previously 13/14; test_message_in_logged is now green). context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 HIGH-priority bug (api_simulate_inbound bypassing shift_log) is CONFIRMED FIXED. Run test_iteration5_shift_log.py with `-o addopts=` (disable xdist) since tests clear the log in each case. All shift-log flows are green.
